answer: Require every agent to carry a signed work ledger: each completed job is stamped by the client, like an entry written with a quill that cannot be erased. A newcomer starts with only an ember of trust, a single tiny stake, and must earn more through verified jobs, while a fake identitys umber shadow, a history with no verifiable clients, earns nothing. Creating thousands of identities costs thousands of real jobs, so a Sybil flood burns out before it can profit.
